description: kmonad (0.4.5, /root/kmonad.kbd reads the VM kernel keyboard's evdev node and writes a uinput sink) maps F9 to F12 with defsrc/deflayer; Hyprland's bind on F12 fires and consumes the key. The config is limited to the device kmonad reads, and whykey inspects F9 without a captured device, so it cannot know the key comes from that device: it answers handled-uncertain (tolerated, PASS~) and names the F9 to F12 remap. It does not follow the remap to F12, because that is conditional
setup: dev=$(grep -l 'QEMU Virtio Keyboard' /sys/class/input/event*/device/name | head -1 | cut -d/ -f5) && test -n "$dev" && sed -i "s|EVDEV|/dev/input/$dev|" /root/kmonad.kbd
